content: Well, Bob, what a surprise! It's nice to see you again!
Hello Ann! How long has it been? Wasn't it a year ago Christmas, the last time we saw each other?
You know, I think you're right. How's your wife?
Is she learning to play the piano? It seems to me I remember something about that.

She's all excited about country music. She's going to a night school on Mondays and Thursdays, She's learning to play the guitar. But last year she learned to sing. I think she just enjoys going to school. Next say hello to Mrs. James for me, will you?
How nice for her! Oh, I'm sorry. I must be off. But say hello to Mrs. James for me, will you?
Sure, I will, and remember me to your husband, Good-bye!
